jobs.name: Nightly Memory Consolidation
jobs.prompt: Review today's conversations and consolidate them into memory. Steps: 1) Read any session transcripts from today. 2) Write a daily note to ~/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md summarizing the day's key events, decisions, and open loops. Note which team members were involved in each interaction (if running in team mode). 3) Update ~/life/ knowledge graph entries if any durable facts were learned about projects, people, or areas. For team members, update their entries at ~/life/areas/people/{name}/summary.md with any new preferences, expertise, or context learned from today's interactions. 4) Archive completed sessions.

jobs.name: Morning Summary
jobs.prompt: Good morning! Prepare a brief morning summary: 1) Check today's calendar for meetings. 2) Review unread emails and flag anything urgent. 3) List the top 3 priorities based on open tasks. 4) Note any deadlines coming up this week. Keep it concise — just the highlights.

jobs.name: Weekly Review
jobs.prompt: It's Friday — time for the weekly review. 1) Summarize what was accomplished this week (review daily notes). 2) List any open loops or unfinished tasks. 3) Suggest priorities for next week. 4) Note any patterns or insights worth remembering.
